v8_game_results.json.scope: Real cricket engine + new UI dispatch in a VM DOM stub. No browser, visual, geometry, focus or latency certification.

v8_smoke_results.json.scope: Real cricket engine + new UI dispatch in a VM DOM stub. No browser, visual, geometry, focus or latency certification.

v8_audit_results.json.scope: VM adversarial saves, storage failures, resume context and stale-command checks; no browser rendering or server exists in this standalone build.

v8_reveal_results.json.scope: VM clock and command tests; proves reveal sequencing/save guards and unchanged draw order, not rendered smoothness.

v8_interaction_results.json.scope: VM dispatch + real trade, supplementary pick and replacement rules. Injury availability fixture is injected, not naturally simulated; no browser validation.

v8_dom_patch_results.json.scope: DOM tree model checks for keyed identity, replacement, insertion, removal, typing and details state. Does not certify native focus, scroll, geometry or appearance.

v8_markup_results.json.scope: Parsed HTML strings from the VM DOM stub; does not validate geometry or visual quality.

clock_checks: Single native runner, pause/resume, cancellation, self-cancelling interval and timers added during a pause passed.
backend: Standalone browser-domain engine and localStorage; no server API exists in this build.
native_visual_alignment: Not verified; no native game screenshots rendered or reviewed.
native_interaction_and_performance: Not verified; VM dispatch and DOM-tree identity are not native focus, scroll, browser persistence, frame timing or smoothness evidence.
